modules.module_title: Check the availability of resources for food packing

pcs.pc_description: determine the packing requirements by speaking to the supervisor
coordinate with the supervisor for the availability of relevant packing equipment and packaging materials
assist in checking if the packaging material conforms to the applicable specifications and quality standards
check for the availability of necessary tools and equipment to attend to faults in case of packing machine breakdowns

modules.module_title: Prepare the packing machine for operation

pcs.pc_description: check the packing machinery and other relevant equipment for any damage, wear, and proper functioning
ensure all safety guards and emergency stop buttons are in place and operational
carry out basic repair and maintenance of the packing machinery
coordinate with the supervisor for complex repair and maintenance needs

modules.module_title: Perform the test run for the packing machine

pcs.pc_description: check the packing machine operating environment meets the necessary conditions such as temperature and humidity
load the packing material in the packing machine, aligning it properly
set the appropriate machine parameters, depending on the type of packing machine being used and the food product being packed
conduct a test run to verify that the product is being packed and sealed correctly
adjust the packing machine settings, as required, based on the test
assist in maintaining records of machine settings and any issues encountered during the setup

modules.module_title: Carry out primary packaging of food products

pcs.pc_description: check the packaging area is clean and organised to maintain food safety standards
assemble the components of the Clean-out- of-Place (COP) equipment properly
sterilize the relevant equipment, such as Ultra-high Temperature (UHT) units, before using them for packing operations
perform integrity testing on the packaging materials as per operational guidelines
sterilize the containers before using them for packing food products
feed food products and primary packaging materials, such as sheets, boxes, cans, plastic rolls, cardboard, and bottles, to the packaging machine
fill the packaging materials with food products manually or using appropriate automated equipment
seal/cap the filled packaging material following the packing machine user guidelines
regulate the speed of packaging to ensure efficient packing operations
monitor the temperature of food products during packing to ensure they are packed at safe temperatures to maintain their quality
monitor the equipment temperature and take appropriate corrective measures in case of deviations from the normal temperature
carry out labelling of the filled/packed primary packaging material
check if food products are packaged according to the applicable specifications
identify, segregate and label the non- standard materials and packages that do not meet the specifications
maintain the supply of packing materials throughout the run
maintain the required output rates
identify discrepancies, non-standard output and any problems, and report them to supervisor for prompt resolution
hand over the standard and non-standard packed products as per the operational guidelines, with minimum damage
shut down the packing production line, during emergencies, as per the organisational procedure

modules.module_title: Carry out secondary packaging of food products

pcs.pc_description: use food-grade secondary packaging that complies with applicable safety standards
collect the required secondary packaging materials, e.g. corrugated cardboard, shrink wrap film, stretch wrap film, paperboard, plastic containers, and tools
check the primary packaged items are sealed and labelled correctly
arrange the primary packaged products into groups as instructed and pack them in secondary packaging
seal the secondary packaging using appropriate sealing methods
carry out labelling of the secondary packaging with the necessary information, e.g. product details, batch number, expiration date, etc
secure the packaged items, as required
examine the finished secondary packaging for any defects or issues and take necessary corrective measures, as instructed

modules.module_title: Carry out tertiary packaging of food products

pcs.pc_description: check the primary packages are grouped and packed appropriately in the secondary packaging
set appropriate parameters in the tertiary packing machine
feed the tertiary packaging materials and secondary packed products in the packing machine
carry out bulk tertiary packaging of packed cartons at the speed to ensure proper packaging
remove tertiary packed product safely from the packaging machine
weigh the packed products after tertiary packaging to ensure correct weight
examine the tertiary packaging material for damage and take appropriate corrective measures, as required
assist in checking all packaging complies with regulatory standards and company policies
adhere to the organisational and FSSAI standards and procedures concerning food processing, packaging, and the operation of food product packing machinery
store the packaged products in a pest- controlled environment, at the appropriate temperature and humidity
handle the packages safely, using appropriate equipment to avoid damage
clean the packing machinery and other tools and equipment using the recommended cleaning agents and sanitizers
follow the appropriate clean-in-place procedure
clean the work area after packaging operations to remove dust, spillage, pests, etc
check the packing machinery and carry out basic repairs, as required
ensure periodic maintenance of all machinery and equipment as per the manufacturer’s instructions/manuals
carry out appropriate documentation concerning the packing machine operations
